author: Coco_stag
body:
Hello,

Suggestion today is... read the title.

The avicus staff members work their ass off to give us avicus. If that comes down to developing moderating or anything else. I know its optional to be a staff member but they still need something in return. I find Staff member of the month will make it better for the staff who do their best.
Basically this reward could be anywhere. A little ingame message or apart of the forums

avicus.net/smtm <--- staff member of the month

Maybe the reward is something special. I don't have anything in mind so I can't tell you.
Leave feedback please!
